appDescription: DAON (다온, '다녀간 곳에 온기를 남기다') lets a family or friends group leave a few warm words at a place or a driving moment. The words are played back later in the other members' cars when they pass that place or meet that moment.

function.name: SAVE_SPOT
function.description: Mark the car's current location as a temporary DAON spot for one of the driver's groups, such as family or friends, so the driver can leave warm words there after parking.

memo.description: Optional short label for the spot in the driver's own words.

group.description: The group this spot is for, as the driver said it: a group type such as family, friends or couple, or the group's name. Omit to use the current group.

function.name: LEAVE_DAON
function.description: Leave a few warm DAON words for one of the driver's groups, such as family or friends, to be played back later in the other members' cars. When they are played back is set in advance in the app, so do not ask the driver about timing.

text.description: The words as the listeners will hear them: one short natural sentence spoken directly to them in the driver's own tone, without request words, the app name, or the group name.

group.description: The group these words are for, as the driver said it: a group type such as family, friends or couple, or the group's name. Omit to use the current group.

useSavedSpot.description: True only when the driver explicitly refers to the spot they saved earlier; otherwise leave this out so the words stay at the current location.

function.name: RECORD_DAON
function.description: Start recording a short spoken message from the driver for one of the driver's groups, such as family or friends; the app then asks for the words and records them itself, so the request does not need to contain the words.

group.description: The exact name of one of the driver's groups, only when the driver said it right before the request. Leave it out otherwise; the current group is used.

useSavedSpot.description: True only when the driver explicitly refers to the spot they saved earlier; otherwise leave this out so the words stay at the current location.
